cycle_1_death.mechanism: Blocked in handler on main thread (main) waiting on lazy ranchu HALs (GNSS HAL native_class_init_once and Fingerprint HAL FingerprintProvider.getHalInstance during startUser 0)
cycle_1_death.root_cause: vendor.gnss.ranchu and vendor.biometrics.fingerprint-service.ranchu are defined with 'class hal', 'oneshot', and 'disabled' in vendor.img. Under QEMU, hwservicemanager continuously floods init's control message queue with requests for missing android.hardware.media.c2@1.0::IComponentStore/software, dropping ctl.interface_start messages for lazy HALs. Furthermore, /system/bin/start is rejected with SELinux ctl_start_prop denial. Unstarted lazy HALs cause SystemServer's main thread to block for over 60-90s until Watchdog kills system_server.
alternatives_ruled_out: PropertyInvalidatedCache lock contention (ruled out by thread stack: no invalidateCacheLocked contention, pure synchronous HAL init wait)
Zygote crash / SIGSEGV (ruled out: Zygote PID remained alive throughout)
Hardware GNSS/Fingerprint failure (ruled out: ranchu HALs are pure software mocks that run successfully when started)

cycle_2_death.root_cause: gatekeeperd is defined with 'class late_start' in system/etc/init/gatekeeperd.rc. In the initramfs boot scripts, class_start late_start is triggered by 'on nonencrypted', which was never executed under QEMU loopback mount. gatekeeperd was never started by init. Additionally, gatekeeperd requires /data/misc/gatekeeper to exist (chdir) and runs as system:system (1000:1000 0700). LockSettingsService.getGateKeeperService() logged 'Unable to acquire GateKeeperService', returned null, and caused a fatal NPE upon device provisioning completion.
alternatives_ruled_out: android.fg FATAL (ruled out: this crash is on the main thread, not android.fg)
Storage/ACL failure (ruled out: ext4 /data and tmpfs /data/media were healthy, user 0 CE storage unlock had not even been reached yet)
Missing HIDL GateKeeper HAL (ruled out: android.hardware.gatekeeper@1.0::IGatekeeper/default PID was running and registered with hwservicemanager; only the gatekeeperd binder daemon was missing)

pinned_fix.hal_daemons: Directly spawn vendor.gnss.ranchu, vendor.biometrics.fingerprint-service.ranchu, and android.hardware.gatekeeper@1.0-service.software from t636-diag.sh prep and supervise them continuously in watch_early_services(), eliminating reliance on dropped ctl.interface_start messages and bypassing ctl_start SELinux restrictions.
pinned_fix.gatekeeperd: Pre-create /data/misc/gatekeeper (0700 1000:1000) in early-ramdisk and t636-diag.sh, directly spawn /system/bin/gatekeeperd /data/misc/gatekeeper from t636-diag.sh prep, ensuring IGateKeeperService is registered with servicemanager before LockSettingsService provisions the device.
